item.title: Snow Report: Cooler temps, some light mountain snow
item.description: We’re seeing a cooler pattern midweek, along with a chance for light mountain snow moving in later today. If you are planning to hit the slopes for spring break... here's a heads up. Several resorts have paused operations today, so it’s a good idea to check resort websites for the latest updates before heading out.
